title: Why Indians Are Choosing Vietnam Over Thailand in 2026 ?
content:
For years, Thailand was the first international trip for many Indians. Easy visa, cheap flights, good food, and beaches. But in 2026, something has clearly changed. More Indian travelers are choosing Vietnam instead of Thailand, and this shift is not random.

It’s based on experience, cost, and comfort.

Thailand Is Still Popular, But It’s Feeling Tired:

Thailand hasn’t become bad, but it has become overcrowded and repetitive. Indian travelers now complain about:

  • Heavy crowds in Bangkok and Phuket,
  • Rising hotel prices during peak season,
  • Over-commercialized experiences,
  • Less personal travel feel,

For first-time travelers, Thailand still works. But repeat travelers want something fresh.

Vietnam Feels New, Clean, and Less Chaotic:

Vietnam gives Indian tourists what Thailand used to give 8 - 10 years ago: value and novelty.

Cities like Hanoi, Da Nang, and Ho Chi Minh City feel modern but not overwhelming. Beaches are cleaner, cafes are unique, and local culture still feels authentic. Travelers don’t feel rushed or trapped in tourist zones.

This matters more than people admit.

Cost Matters More Than Ever in 2026:

Vietnam is cheaper in ways that actually affect your trip:

  • Hotels offer better quality at the same price
  • Local food is affordable and hygienic
  • Internal travel is well-organized and cost-effective

Thailand has become expensive silently. Vietnam still feels fair.

Visa and Entry Are Easier Than You Think:

Vietnam’s visa process for Indians has improved a lot. E-visa approvals are faster and clearer now. Travelers feel more confident booking Vietnam compared to before. Thailand, on the other hand, keeps changing rules, which creates confusion.

Indian Travelers Want Calm, Not Just Party:

This is the biggest shift. Many Indian couples, families, and even solo travelers now want:

  • Scenic views
  • Cafes and slow travel
  • Culture and photography
  • Less noise, less crowd

Vietnam fits this mindset perfectly.

What best:

Thailand isn’t disappearing, but Vietnam is clearly becoming the new favorite for Indians in 2026. It’s not about hype. It’s about better experience for the same budget.

Travel trends always change. Smart travelers notice early.
